catalysts.what: Q3 2026 results: revenue $94.9M vs FactSet est $92M (+4% y/y), software revenue +11%, adj. EBITDA margin 31.8%, net income $5.6M; services soft and full-year revenue growth guidance narrowed to 2%-3%. Shares gapped up to a 52-week high (close 12.18 on 2026-11-05).
Post-earnings coverage: shares climbed on software momentum and margin expansion despite year-to-date losses.

event_risks: Short interest about 26% of float: squeeze potential, but also volatile reversals (-3.2% on 2026-11-11, pre-market about 11.57).
Services segment decline and narrowed guidance (2%-3% growth) are a fundamental soft spot.
No S-3/424B5 or other offering filing in the last 10 days. Filings were only the 10-Q and an 8-K item 2.02/9.01, both from 2026-11-05.
No takeover bid, litigation or regulatory probe in the packet.
Next earnings are expected around Feb 2027, outside the 20-business-day window. No other scheduled events were found in the packet.
notes: The move came from the Q3 earnings beat on 2026-11-05: revenue beat, software growth accelerated and margins expanded. The stock rose from 11.09 to 12.18 on that day and has since pulled back to about 11.73. The software-driven margin story is likely to persist, but the services weakness and narrowed guidance limit the upside. The earnings catalyst is already priced in and no new news has appeared since 2026-11-06, so the pullback looks like ordinary consolidation. There is no offering or M&A pinning risk, and no binary event falls in the next 20 business days. Net score is mildly positive.
